note: Recorded compiler-model responses for fixture mode. Response 0 contains a deliberate guard overlap so the bounded repair loop is exercised; response 1 is the repaired draft.

supplier-onboarding-draft.1.justification: Scope limits are enforced by the trusted tool catalog and capability ceiling: no activation, bank-change, messaging or payment tool exists in the catalog.

intake.1.justification: READ_INTAKE uses documents.read, which returns only referenced documents and checks their hashes.

intake.2.justification: REQUEST_INPUT bounded by input_requests (bound 1); still missing -> END_UNVERIFIED.

supplier-identity.2.justification: Any lookup_status other than new routes to FALLBACK (stop for review).

drafting.1.justification: Local instruction of EXTRACT_DRAFT; source_refs are checked deterministically by draft.validate.

drafting.2.justification: Local instruction plus structural controls: models cannot select tools, write engine variables or grant approval.

approval.1.justification: REQUEST_APPROVAL precedes PERSIST_DRAFT (ORD-3); broker checks an authenticated approval bound to the argument digest; approver authority is a host precondition.

approval.2.justification: Enforced by the host broker, not by a machine state: approval binds the canonical argument digest, so any draft change invalidates it and the machine path back through VALIDATE_DRAFT and REQUEST_APPROVAL is required.

persistence-and-verification.1.justification: erp.create_draft is dispatched by the broker with a stable idempotency key and business reference.

persistence-and-verification.3.justification: END_VERIFIED_DRAFT requires a current draft.verify_persisted receipt (ORD-4).

persistence-and-verification.4.justification: Enforced by the host runtime: an uncertain effect puts the run in RECONCILING and the broker looks the record up by business reference before any retry.
